scope.note: OIS/futures policy-pricing is a separate temporal-PIT phase because contract-month/meeting mapping and exchange settlement availability require different semantics.

purpose: Define fail-closed temporal availability rules for historical 2Y/10Y rates so a backtest can only see observations that were actually knowable at the decision point.

canonical_rules.date_only_availability_rule: If an official observation has a date but no independently verified publication timestamp, it is NOT eligible for a decision on the same date. It becomes eligible only at the next decision point after that observation date.
canonical_rules.intraday_rule: A same-day observation may be used intraday only when an official publication/settlement timestamp is captured and decision_timestamp is strictly after that timestamp.
canonical_rules.daily_backtest_default: For daily backtests, use the latest eligible official same-basis 2Y/10Y pair strictly known before the decision point. Without verified same-day timestamp, D data may first affect D+1 decisions.
canonical_rules.stale_data_rule: Stale but previously validated data may be carried forward with an explicit stale/withheld flag; it must never be silently replaced by a different source or tenor basis.
canonical_rules.revision_rule: Historical market-yield observations are treated as market observations, not macro vintages. Any later correction by the official publisher must retain correction provenance; backtests must not silently backfill a corrected value into an earlier decision snapshot unless the correction timestamp is also represented.

USD.source: U.S. Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve

GBP.source: UK nominal government zero-coupon spot curve

CHF.source: Spot interest rates on Swiss Confederation bonds
CHF.rule: Do not mix separately published 10Y with another 2Y source; preserve last validated same-basis pair until official export is restored.

CAD.source: Selected benchmark Government of Canada bond yields

AUD.source: F2 Capital Market Yields – Government Bonds – Daily
AUD.cadence_note: Observations are daily; official F2 publication cadence is weekly. Availability must follow publication availability, not observation date alone.

NZD.source: B2 Wholesale interest rates – government bond close
NZD.rule: Do not substitute a secondary source when GitHub-hosted runners receive HTTP 403 from the official B2 endpoints.

required_invariants: 2Y and 10Y share the same official source family and observation date
decision snapshots never include a row whose first_eligible_decision_point is after the snapshot decision point
source identity is retained for every row
two independent materializations produce the same semantic rowset

next_target.reason: Official U.S. Treasury daily par-yield history is direct, same-basis and the cleanest first implementation of the rates temporal-PIT materializer.
next_target.deliverable: Read-only historical 2Y/10Y materializer plus double-replay evidence; no production apply.
